newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Armed Chinese naval ships seen in Spratlys - Manila.
newsitem.headline: Armed Chinese naval ships seen in Spratlys - Manila.

text.p: The Philippines sighted three armed Chinese naval ships last Friday near islands claimed by Manila in the Spratlys and is filing a diplomatic protest to China, the presidential palace said on Tuesday.

A palace statement said one of the ships was identified as belonging to the "Shuguang 04 class" and was accompanied by two smalling fishing boats while another vessel has been identified as belonging to the "Hai" class.
The ships were of the frigate type and armed with deck guns, it said.

"The Department of Foreign Affairs is sending a diplomatic protest to its counterpart in Beijing and will inform its ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) counterparts of these developments," the statement added.

The Spratlys is a cluster of potentially oil-rich islands, reefs and atolls in the South China Sea which are being claimed wholly or in part by China, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Brunei.
